answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when a duplicate identity is proven, so each fake identity costs real capital. Like a juniper that survives by growing slowly, reputation should accrue only from verified completed work, not from account age, so the ripple of one fake agent cannot spread; an attacker must fund thousands of stakes whose combined cost exceeds any reward, while honest agents keep their stake like a relic of good behavior.
